claim: On June 30, 2023 Amazon AppFlow started to support version 58.0 of the Salesforce Platform API.
question: Which Salesforce Platform API version does AppFlow use, and since when?

qualifiers.scope: Salesforce Platform API version used by AppFlow

note: d033. The Salesforce connector page says AppFlow transfers data with version 58.0 and began supporting it on June 30, 2023; connections created before that date use a prior API version.
